title: Graphs from text
description: Explore directed paths, cycles, and weighted edges drawn locally from text.

questions.question: What is the out-degree of vertex b?
questions.description:
```graph
a > b > c
b > d > e
```
hints: Count only the arrows leaving b, not those entering it.
questions.explanation: Vertex b has two outgoing edges: b → c and b → d. The edge a → b is incoming.

questions.question: Which path is a directed cycle?
questions.description:
```graph
a > b > c > a
c > d
```
hints: A cycle follows the arrow directions and returns to its starting vertex.
questions.explanation: The edges a → b, b → c, and c → a form a directed cycle. Vertex d has no outgoing edges.

questions.question: What is the total weight of the path Start → Middle → End?
hints: Add the weights of the two edges used by that path.
questions.explanation: The path uses edges of weights 3 and 5, totaling 8. The direct edge from Start to End has weight 10.
